newsitem.title: USA: Gish Biomedical wins FDA OK for oxygenator.
newsitem.headline: Gish Biomedical wins FDA OK for oxygenator.

text.p: Gish Biomedical Inc said on Tuesday the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has granted marketing clearance for the company's oxygenator, called Vision, paving the way for a limited release next year and full launch in spring 1997.

"This is a significant addition to our cardiovascular product line and will substantially expand the potential market for Gish's products to approximately $350 million from a target cardiovascular market of $175 million today," Jack Brown, chairman, said in a statement.
The Vision oxygenator is a component of a cardiovascular circuit, essentially replacing the activity of the lungs during surgery, Gish said.
The product enables gas exchange of oxygen and carbon dioxide, while regulating the patient's blood temperature.
The company plans to sell its oxygenator as a separate but integral component of the cardiovascular bypass circuit through its direct sales force.
